notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms Georgia list places this tower: 539 ft (164 m), Muscogee County, source note 'topo', and no GFC code (the other two list entries have one). No status, build date, design, staffing or fire record was found in two searches or the caches. The Harris County 1955 item is about another county; the story uses it only for general context and says so. The story is about 100 words, under the 120-word floor, because nothing else turned up. Caution: search results show a Columbus neighbourhood called Carver Heights; nothing links it to this tower, so do not connect them without a source. A check of Muscogee County or Columbus records is the next step.
